jobs.description: Adjunct Faculty - BA 140 Business Analytics 1 — Data Visualization About the Role Ensign College is seeking an adjunct faculty member to teach Business Analytics 1 — Data Visualization within the Business Analytics Certificate program. This is a foundational course that introduces students to the principles and practice of data visualization for business decision-making. Students will learn to connect to data sources, transform and model data, build meaningful visualizations, and present findings through interactive dashboards — using both Power BI and Tableau as their primary tools. Rather than training students on one platform, the goal is to develop visualization literacy: the ability to choose the right tool for the task, design for an audience, and tell a clear story with data. Students will gain hands-on proficiency in both Power BI and Tableau, learning to evaluate the strengths of each in different business contexts. The ideal candidate brings both technical depth and teaching instinct. We’re looking for someone who can help students think critically about what their data is telling them.
